title: 'She cheated on me': SBI banker kills wife, sister; posts chilling WhatsApp status

The employee then turned the gun on himself, ending the tragic sequence. A WhatsApp status accusing his wife of cheating was found. Police are investigating the marital dispute and the events.

title: ‘Why is she wearing shorts’: How family outing at Pune fort turned into assault
content: Police registered a case against eight right-wing outfit members after an assault.  The incident occurred at Sinhagad Fort following an argument over a girl's attire.  The group allegedly questioned and then physically assaulted the complainant and his family.  Similar complaints were also received from other visitors to the historical fort.  Authorities have launched a search to apprehend the eight accused individuals.

title: Spain break 23-year-old cricket record held by Ponting and Waugh's Australia
content: Spain are currently playing in the Men's T20 World Cup Sub Regional Europe Qualifiers in Southern Finland and have won all their matches in the tournament so far. Their latest victory came against Bulgaria on August 18, when they chased down a target of 60 in just 29 deliveries, winning by nine wickets.

title: 'RSS believes it knows the truth for everyone': Rahul attacks Sangh over ideology
content: Speaking at the "Hara Bhara Swaraj: A Tribute to Rajiv Gandhi's Vision" programme, the Gandhi Scion described the ideological contest in India as a deeper struggle over how people understand themselves, freedom and their place in society. The Congress leader also drew a distinction between the RSS's worldview and Mahatma Gandhi's idea of 'Swaraj', saying no organisation or individual could claim to know what is true for another person.

title: Google CEO shares photos in honor of 'World Photography Day' taken by Pixel 11 phones
content: Sundar Pichai, the CEO of Google, proudly showcased stunning images captured on the new Pixel 11 smartphone. These photos underscored the innovative camera technology and software the device offers. The Pixel 11 series features impressive optical upgrades and is empowered by Gemini Intelligence. With a robust 48MP main camera and an ultrawide counterpart, the device excels in low-light scenarios thanks to tools like Instant Night Sight.

title: BWF Worlds: Treesa-Gayatri stun 7th seeds to reach quarters, medal one win away
content: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a World Championships quarterfinal spot.  The unseeded Indian pair defeated Japan's seventh seeds in straight games.  Treesa's aggressive play and Gayatri's structural support proved decisive.  This victory marks a significant step in their comeback after Treesa's injury.  A medal is now guaranteed with one more win at the event.

title: Microsoft AI CMO Andra Mallard leaves after just 6 months
content: Microsoft AI's chief marketing officer, Andra Mallard, is leaving the company soon. She plans to relocate her family to Europe for personal reasons next August. Mallard's departure coincides with a strategic marketing shift within Microsoft's AI division. The company is consolidating its Copilot apps into a single unified application. This move follows broader changes within the Microsoft AI unit.

title: Told he had months to live, Seattle shipbuilder survived another 38 years
content: Robert Moran, Seattle's former mayor, made a monumental gift of thousands of acres for a state park. Following a serious illness, he relocated to Orcas Island, where he developed picturesque forest lands into a personal estate. His visionary donation led to the establishment of Washington's first state park, named Moran State Park in his honor, which remains a beloved destination to this day.

title: 30% of Japan's temples could disappear by 2040; monks turn to AI
content: By 2040, Japanese temples may face closure due to dwindling religious commitment among the populace. In a bid to attract more visitors spiritually, monks are embracing artificial intelligence to improve operational efficiency and enhance communication with worshippers. While some view AI as a useful guide in matters of faith, others argue that the essential human connection is irreplaceable.

title: Google’s Spirit Airlines email deal faces ‘obstacle’ from flight attendants’ union
content: A US bankruptcy court has postponed Google's acquisition of Spirit Airlines' digital archives due to privacy issues raised by former flight attendants. The union expressed concerns that the agreement does not sufficiently shield employee records from AI training misuse. Google assured that any data shared would be anonymized prior to third-party access. The court plans to examine the union's allegations before issuing a final ruling.

title: 'My best shot': Nasa astronaut shares image of 2025 Maha Kumbh taken from space
content: Astronaut Donald Pettit has unveiled breathtaking photographs of the 2025 Maha Kumbh Mela, captured from the International Space Station. These stunning images showcase the vibrant Hindu pilgrimage, shimmering against the vast darkness of space. The event, held in Prayagraj, attracted millions for ritual bathing, marking it as one of the largest gatherings in human history. This expedition also contributed to ongoing scientific research efforts.

title: No 2800 km dash this time: Qamran Iqbal arrives early, ready for Duleep Trophy challenge
content: Called up less than 24 hours before the Ranji Trophy final, Qamran Iqbal travelled nearly 2,800 km from Srinagar to Hubballi before scoring an unbeaten 160 that helped Jammu and Kashmir win their maiden title. The 24-year-old reflects on the whirlwind journey, J&K's rise and his ambition to shine in the Duleep Trophy. North Zone will take on West Zone at the BCCI’s Centre of Excellence (CoE) from Sunday.

title: NCERT recasts political science textbook panel; 4 with RSS links among 20 members
content: NCERT has recast the team for preparing political science textbooks for Classes XI and XII, with one of the two books slated to be ready by Nov. The 20-member panel includes faculty from JNU, DU, IGNOU and NLU Delhi, among others. At least four members have links, past or present, with organisations associated with RSS-BJP.

title: In dry Gujarat, spurious booze kills 6 at party thrown by cop; 25 in hospital
content: Six people died and twenty-five were hospitalized after drinking methanol-spiked liquor.  The incident occurred in Bhavnagar district, with victims consuming liquor from Royal Stag bottles.  Questions arose regarding alleged police reporting delays, prompting an investigation by the State Monitoring Cell.  Patients reported breathlessness and vision loss, with officials warning of kidney complications.  The liquor was manufactured and sold locally in Bhavnagar, and suspects have been detained.

title: US Army eyes mobile K9 howitzer to replace M777; India too shifts towards wheeled artillery
content: The US Army is testing South Korea's K9 Mobile Howitzer for potential replacement of towed systems. This move aligns with India's ongoing artillery modernization efforts under its rationalization plan. India is developing indigenous systems and incorporating local content into foreign designs. Both nations seek enhanced mobility and longer-range artillery capabilities for future conflicts. This shift reflects a global recognition of modern artillery's essential requirements.

title: Why model Rhiya Ahir is in spotlight: Details on education, career
content: Rhiya Ahir, also known as Rhiya Ekousiya, is a Mumbai-based model, actor and entrepreneur who gained nationwide attention after a July 2026 student protest in Mumbai. A viral video showed her standing in front of a police van carrying detained protesters at Shivaji Park. Ahir, 27, studied Psychology before pursuing an English Literature degree through distance education. She has also trained extensively in theatre and founded Rhiyasat, a luxury handcrafted apparel label supporting Indian artisans.

title: Bulldozers roll outside Pakistan High Commission in Delhi; barricades removed
content: Indian authorities removed the external security cordon around the Pakistan High Commission. Traffic bollards and barricades were dismantled from the diplomatic compound premises. This action effectively eliminated the external security perimeter outside the high commission. The Pakistan High Commission is situated within the Chanakyapuri diplomatic enclave.

title: Not Anderson or Broad: Ollie Robinson pulls off a first in England Test history

title: Half of UK homes take longer to sell as buyers adopt ‘wait & see’ approach: Here’s why
content: A significant shift is occurring in the UK housing market, as half of British homes are now taking longer to sell compared to the previous year. Factors such as mortgage market turbulence and uncertainties regarding borrowing costs are causing potential buyers to hesitate. While Scotland presents the quickest sales, other regions are facing frustrating delays, pressured by inflation worries and potential interest rate increases.

title: ‘Strong values around Test cricket’: Gary Kirsten reveals chat with Gambhir
content: Gautam Gambhir and Gary Kirsten engaged in an enlightening conversation about the myriad challenges of coaching and the foundational principles of Test cricket. With Gambhir leading India and Kirsten at the helm for Sri Lanka, their aligned perspectives on team strategies emerged. Gambhir's impressive coaching record is complemented by Kirsten's previous support of him, while India recently enjoyed a memorable victory against Sri Lanka in the Galle Test.

title: Tarun Tejpal moves SC against Bombay HC conviction, 10-year jail term
content: Tarun Tejpal has appealed the Bombay high court's conviction and ten-year sentence.  The high court overturned his earlier acquittal in a 2013 sexual assault case.  He was convicted of raping a junior colleague in a Goa hotel elevator.  The Goa government also seeks a life sentence, deeming the current punishment lenient.  Tejpal previously claimed political targeting in the ongoing legal proceedings.

title: ‘Manan, it’s done bro’: Dipke calls ‘legal cockroaches’ to protest against BCI chief

The All India Young Advocates Association is organizing the demonstration.  The BCI chairman had previously apologized to law students for his words.  The protest seeks accountability and the chairman's resignation from his position.

title: 'Don't daydream about my jawani': Kangana Ranaut to Baba Ramdev

Both figures engaged in a public dispute following Ranaut's controversial statements.

title: Andhra woman dies in freak accident after elevator moves with door open

The victim, Vanitha, was caught off guard and suffered severe injuries. She was rushed to the hospital but succumbed to her injuries later. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

title: Rajdhani waits as 90 jumbos cross rail tracks

Effective coordination protects wildlife in elephant corridors.

title: Gandhi manuscript fetches Rs 16.2 crore at Saffronart, sets world auction record
content: a thought for the day isn’t just a WhatsApp forward; it can be worth a fortune if it’s written in Bapu’s hand . on Wednesday, Mahatma Gandhi’s ‘A Thought of the Day’ sold for Rs 16.2 crore ($1.7 million) at a Saffronart auction .

title: Scientists discovered four snakes curled together in a burrow for 38 million years
content: four complete skeletons have helped researchers understand an early member of the ‘boa family’ and the history of small, burrowing snakes in north America . three of the snakes were preserved together in a burrow-like cast, while a fourth specimen from the same formation provided additional evidence for identifying the species .

title: 'Anti-national decision': Amit Shah on Congress's Vande Mataram resolution
content: amit Shah criticises the Congress over its decision to sing only the first two stanzas of the national song Vande Mataram . the move is "anti-national," he says . "they have not only insulted this creation of Bankim Babu but also lakhs of people who laid down their lives for the freedom of the country"

title: Half of Maharashtra homeopathy colleges have political links
content: out of 72 private homeopathy medical colleges in Maharashtra, at least 34 (47%) are established by trusts or societies that have political connections cutting across party lines . these colleges with strong political connections account for almost 3,000 seats, or about half of the total homeopathy seats in the state .

title: Dehradun cave party: Men with large speaker dance inside Robber's Cave
content: the video was reportedly filmed at a cave in dehradun, Uttarakhand . it shows the men singing and dancing as they make their way through a section of the cave . users have called out what they described as a lack of civic sense .

title: NALSAR row sparks fresh protest: Lawyers demand resignation of BCI chief Manan Mishra
content: lawyers protest outside the bar Council of India office demanding resignation of chairman Manan Kumar Mishra . the protest came days after the council’s now-withdrawn order targeting the enrolment of NALSAR University’s graduating batch drew criticism from sections of the legal fraternity .

title: Who was Sajjan Kumar? From 3-time Congress MP to 1984 riots convict
content: former congress leader was serving a life sentence in 1984 anti-sikh riots . he was among the close allies of Indira Gandhi's younger son, Sanjay . his political career halted after being accused of rioting former prime minister .

title: 'Papa looking down proudly': Rahul, Priyanka's emotional note for 'Mama' Sonia Gandhi
content: the messages came on the birth anniversary of their father, former prime minister Rajiv Gandhi . both Rahul and Priyanka will release their memoir 'Belonging: a Journey of Love' the messages reflect the relationship of their parents and the personal losses they endured .

title: China puts 'robocops' on traffic duty; a 'Superman' robot claims it can outrun Bolt
content: the 1.88-metre, 98-kg robot, developed by SUPCON Information, is being deployed to handle routine traffic-control duties . it uses cameras, radar and onboard computing to identify helmetless e-bike riders, passengers on ebikes, vehicles crossing stop lines and pedestrians violating signals . the robot has no power to arrest and does not carry a gun .

title: NET row: AI used recklessly to draft questions, say experts
content: experts say generative AI was used extensively to prepare papers . the controversy has forced the national testing agency to order new exams in English, commerce and sociology . a six-week delay in cancelling three flawed tests is at the heart of the UGC-NET controversy .

title: 'Illiterate govt': Kejriwal takes aim at Centre over E20 fuel policy, sugar prices
content: arvind Kejriwal said the government had promoted ethanol production from sugarcane to reduce foreign exchange spending on crude oil imports . he also attacked the government over its handling of the issue, saying, "no one knows what will happen if they do something"
